title: Finite-stage rational categories are Karoubian
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $T$ be a noetherian scheme of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible. The raw rational category $\mathcal C_E=\Dbc(T,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] is idempotent complete: every endomorphism $e:K\to K$ with $e^2=e$ admits an object $L$ and maps $i:L\to K$, $r:K\to L$ with $ri=\operatorname{id}_L$ and $ir=e$. Moreover, the canonical functor
$$
 J:\mathcal C_E\longrightarrow\Kar(\mathcal C_E),\qquad K\longmapsto(K,\operatorname{id}_K),\qquad f\longmapsto f,
$$
of [def-weil-karoubi-envelope] is an exact equivalence of triangulated categories.

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states this form: Stacks has no
idempotent completion (Homological Algebra, Section 12.4, [Tag
09SF](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09SF), states only the Karoubian
property, Definition 12.4.1, [Tag
09SG](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09SG), with the splitting
criterion of Lemma 12.4.2, [Tag
09SH](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09SH), and the criteria of Lemma
12.4.3, [Tag 05QV](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05QV)) and no
t-structure, so the Karoubianity of a triangulated category carrying a
bounded t-structure is not available; the blueprint adds the Karoubianity of
the finite-stage rational categories, deduced from the bounded t-structure
of [prop-weil-localized-tstructure] and the Karoubianity theorem for bounded
t-structures proved in this manuscript.

proof.text: Put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and choose a uniformizer $\varpi$. By [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], the category in the statement is precisely $\mathcal C_E=\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi]$, with the same objects as the integral category and with morphisms $\operatorname{Hom}_{\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)}(K,L)\otimes_A E$. In particular it is the raw scalar localization, rather than a category defined by first taking a Karoubi envelope. This identifies the category to which the next step applies.

source.place: Proof, identification of the category named in the first sentence; rational-category definition

proof.text: Apply [prop-weil-localized-tstructure] to this $T$, $E$, and $A$. Its hypotheses are exactly that $\ell$ is prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, and $T$ is noetherian of finite dimension with $\ell$ invertible, all assumed here. It equips the same raw localization $\mathcal C_E$ with a triangulated structure and a bounded t-structure. Only this unconditional bounded-t-structure assertion is used: the proposition's additional Tor-compatibility hypothesis belongs to its levelwise truncation computation, which is not used here.

source.place: Proof, first clause: the rational category carries a bounded t-structure

proof.text: Use [thm-weil-karoubian-bounded-t] with $\mathcal T=\mathcal C_E$ and the bounded t-structure from step 2. Its triangulated-category and boundedness hypotheses have both been supplied by that step. Its first conclusion gives a splitting for each idempotent $e:K\to K$, which is exactly the asserted idempotent completeness. Its second conclusion states that the canonical fully faithful functor $\mathcal T\to\Kar(\mathcal T)$ is an exact equivalence. Under this substitution it is the displayed $J$, so it gives the entire second clause, including exactness; no separate inference from ordinary categorical equivalence to exactness is needed.

source.place: Proof, final clause: apply the Karoubianity theorem for bounded t-structures, including its exact-equivalence conclusion

proof_origin.place: Proof, the single paragraph expanded into identification, bounded t-structure, and the two conclusions of the existing general theorem
